name: NFL ML Predictions API
description: NFL Game Prediction System using Machine Learning with FastAPI backend

APP_ENV.description: Runtime environment label for the deployed backend

RESTRICT_CORS.description: Enforce exact-origin CORS checks in production

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Canonical frontend origin allowed to call the API

ALLOW_VERCEL_PREVIEWS.description: Allow preview deployments via regex fallback

CORS_ORIGINS_REGEX.description: Regex used for Vercel preview deployment origins

ENABLE_ADMIN.description: Expose admin-only endpoints like /admin/reload (disable in production)

DATA_DIR.description: Directory containing game_features_*.csv datasets (relative to backend/)

SCHEDULE_PATH.description: Optional packaged schedule CSV override relative to backend/

MODELS_DIR.description: Path to the canonical packaged model bundle relative to backend/

OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Primary expert-layer Ollama model. Use a cloud model with OLLAMA_API_KEY for deployed expert predictions.

OLLAMA_BASE_URL.description: Comma-separated Ollama host candidates. Production should prefer Ollama Cloud.

OLLAMA_API_KEY.description: Ollama Cloud API key for expert predictions. Do not commit a value.
